WG Agent-supported editor: cycle 2026-11-03 11:30 to 2026-11-04 11:30 UTC
Pause: running (the 11-03 report is the only one without a 👍 so far).

1. Decisions for you: one, carried, unchanged. Question: can an essay container declare its comments and references as children, so one export carries the whole essay, while agents can still file comments? Why it matters: two of your rulings collide (an essay exports whole; agents never write the essay, they comment). Options: A engine guard stops at declared children (srs-rust change, then srs-web#634 builds as planned); B keep the snapshot bundle, widened to carry threads; C a different path for agent comments; D nothing. Recommendation: A. Action needed: decide. Urgency: blocks srs-web#634; no data at risk. Record 42fcc319-2468-4e15-b529-2c13f9174af6 (proposed). Also waiting: needs-input on srs-web#567 and #634.
2. Decided within mandate: none. No group decision record awaited assent, so no group session was held. (srs-web#690 names one decision in its PR block, "Answer a candidate with a comment response on the source, not a new field", with reviewer assent; it has no record in the group log yet, so there is nothing to ratify. It needs a proposed record from the builder.)
3. Done: no delegated merges. You merged seven group PRs during this cycle: srs-web#688 (notes tray), #689 (changes since last save), #690 (references candidates), #687 (browse essays), #702, #703, #705 (the essay home, three parts). Quorum lines: #688, #689, #690 builder editor-builder / reviewer editor-reviewer, approved, mandate affirmed remedies; #687 and #702/#703 reviewer rejected (remedy 6176df56 and 6848d96e were only suggested, since affirmed by your fork d3fe4ba6 for 6848d96e); #705 carries no quorum comment I could find.
4. Stuck or lost: srs-web#708 (agent-created source reads back as a candidate, #626) is open, owner-merge, CI preview deployed, no reviewer quorum comment yet. srs-web#634 stopped on the decision above. Blocked: semanticops.com#14. Check: srs-web#698 and #699 are still labelled ready though their PRs (#702, #703) merged; the issues may need closing. #705 merged with no reviewer line, so its mandate is unchecked.
5. Budget: 0 of 10 delegated merges this cycle; 0 open counted (owner-merge PRs do not count). Pause: running.
5b. Awaiting ratification: none from the group. The essay-home decisions D1 to D3 are in the SemanticOps log under your hand.
6. Next: ready + wg:agent-editor: srs-web#699, #698 (likely done, see 4), #626, #601, #525 usable; #634 stopped; semanticops.com#14 blocked. Top 3 in builder order: #626, #601, #525. Queue fed for about 1 cycle. Waits on you: the escalation, review and merge of #708, a 👍 on this report.
6b. Exercises: none open.
7. What we learned: owner-merge stayed the path: seven group PRs merged by you in one day while the delegated budget sat at 0 of 10, and the reviewer's rejections were all one cause (a suggested remedy, not an affirmed one), which your forks fixed after the fact. A decision named in a PR block but never made a record is invisible to the steward: the builder should file the proposed record. I1: nothing to measure (0 delegated merges in the window, nothing written). I2 to I4: pending. Fed by the analyst: not needed.
